evidenceQualityRules.valid: Evidence directly measures the stated competency.
evidenceQualityRules.sufficient: Enough evidence exists to support the decision.
evidenceQualityRules.authentic: Evidence can reasonably be attributed to the learner.
evidenceQualityRules.current: Evidence reflects present knowledge or behaviour.
evidenceQualityRules.consistent: Competency is demonstrated across multiple activities.
evidenceQualityRules.transparent: Questions, standards and marking criteria are visible.
